title: Product Manager 1
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast. **Job Summary**


This job is responsible for defining and guiding the introduction of new data\- and technology\-based products, coordinating cross\-functional efforts. It involves planning and developing innovative features for existing programs, ensuring alignment with market needs. The role is key to managing the product lifecycle from concept to launch.**Job Description**

**Responsibilities:**

* Analyzing product management activities, defining product concepts, and justifying product\-related expenditures
* Assisting other product managers in solving semi\-complex problems and guiding them through larger project initiatives
* Managing profit and loss or budgetary aspects for assigned products, ensuring alignment with company goals
* Evaluating market trends, consumer needs, and technological advancements to inform product strategy
* Developing detailed product features, requirements, and implementation plans, prioritizing based on market needs
* Envisioning new product features through participation in cross\-functional teams, fostering innovation and collaboration
* Coordinating with external vendors and strategic partners to ensure timely, on\-budget delivery of product initiatives
* Reviewing and adjusting pricing strategies to maintain market competitiveness and company profitability
* Conducting periodic margin analyses to identify opportunities for product improvement and cost optimization
* Ensuring seamless coordination among cross\-functional teams to achieve product launch and lifecycle objectives
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

* Overall, 8 yrs in product management
* 5\-6 yrs of relevant experience in data domain
* Deep understanding of modern architectures (AWS, DWH, Snowflake, Server Management)
* Working knowledge of privacy regulations (CCPA, CPRA etc)
* Responsible for taking accountability in delivering product roadmap
* Agile in critical problem\-solving, functional orientation
* Good appetite for continuous improvement and innovation
* Excellent in stakeholder management
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance
* Constant drive for innovation/change
* Able to set, track and measure goals
* Able to organize the time and priorities
* Able to inspire the team members by building trust and transparency

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game\-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

**Disclaimer:** This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.


Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

  

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non\-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best\-in\-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always\-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality \- to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

 **Education**


Bachelor's Degree


While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.

**Relevant Work Experience**


7\-10 Years

title: Principal Technical Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

Help build the enterprise AI runtime and agentic platform that will power AI solutions across Optum.

  

AI Factory Runtime and Agentic Platform Services provides a secure, scalable platform that enables engineering teams to deploy and operate AI workloads and agents across private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid environments.

  

As Principal Technical Product Manager \- AI Runtime, Agentic Platform \& Compute, you will own the product strategy for this critical layer of AI Factory. You will transform GPU compute, Kubernetes, model serving, inference, agent runtimes, agent orchestration, multi\-agent execution, lifecycle management, and observability into enterprise services that development teams can easily consume.

  

You will define the product vision, roadmap, service model, and investment priorities while partnering with Engineering, Compute, Cloud, Security, Governance, Risk, Compliance, and Architecture leaders to build a high\-performance enterprise AI platform.

  

This role owns the AI runtime, compute, and operational agent platform experience. It does not own underlying physical infrastructure, enterprise model approval and Responsible AI policy processes, or the business\-specific agents, AI applications, and solutions built by consuming teams.

  

AI can only scale across the enterprise when engineering teams have secure, reliable, and easy\-to\-consume runtime and agent platform capabilities beneath their solutions.

  

You will turn advanced GPU, Kubernetes, AI runtime, and agent execution technologies into standardized enterprise services that help teams move AI workloads and agents into production faster, while integrating with enterprise\-approved model access, security, and governance services.

  

This is an opportunity to shape a foundational AI platform serving one of the world's largest healthcare enterprises and influence how engineering teams securely deploy and operate AI workloads and agents at enterprise scale.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for AI Factory Runtime and Agentic Platform Services across private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid environments
* Define clear product boundaries, ownership, and integration points across AI Factory, Compute, Cloud, Security, Governance, Architecture, enterprise AI enablement services, and consuming AI solution teams
* Productize GPU compute, Kubernetes/OpenShift, model serving, LLM inference, agent runtimes, agent orchestration, multi\-agent execution, agent lifecycle management, and platform APIs into standardized services engineering teams can easily consume
* Define the roadmap and service model for operational agent platform capabilities, including agent deployment, execution, orchestration, scaling, lifecycle management, observability, tool connectivity, and governance integration
* Create a leading developer experience, including self\-service onboarding, service tiers, APIs, SLOs/SLAs, documentation, consumption models, and platform automation
* Develop a deep understanding of AI workload, agent workload, and customer requirements and translate them into platform capabilities, architecture priorities, and measurable business outcomes
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to evolve AI runtime and agent platform capabilities across private cloud, Azure, AWS, GCP, and hybrid environments while abstracting infrastructure complexity from consumers
* Partner with Security, Governance, Risk, and Compliance teams to incorporate security, privacy, Responsible AI, observability, and governance requirements into platform services without duplicating enterprise policy, model approval, or governance ownership
* Partner with Compute and Cloud Engineering to understand workload demand and improve GPU utilization, capacity efficiency, platform performance, reliability, and cost effectiveness
* Drive enterprise adoption and measure success through outcomes such as time\-to\-first\-workload, time\-to\-first\-agent, platform utilization, reliability, onboarding speed, adoption, and customer satisfaction
* Influence senior technology leaders and drive decisions across competing customer, engineering, architecture, security, operational, and investment priorities
* Technology Environment
	+ This role will influence a modern enterprise AI runtime and agentic platform incorporating technologies and practices such as:
	+ Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift
	+ NVIDIA GPU platforms
	+ GPU\-enabled container workloads
	+ AI model serving and inference
	+ Agent runtimes
	+ Agent orchestration and multi\-agent execution
	+ Agent lifecycle management
	+ Tool and API connectivity
	+ Public and private cloud
	+ APIs and automation
	+ GitOps
	+ Observability and telemetry
	+ Platform engineering
	+ Experience with every technology is not expected. We are looking for someone with strong platform fundamentals who can rapidly understand emerging AI and agentic technologies and translate them into enterprise products
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10\+ years of experience across technical product management, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, architecture, or related technology leadership roles, including significant product ownership or product leadership experience
* Experience owning, designing, or shaping an enterprise platform, developer platform, cloud service, Kubernetes platform, distributed compute platform, agent platform, or comparable technology product
* Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, service models, SLOs/SLAs, adoption metrics, consumption models, and investment priorities
* Solid understanding of Kubernetes/container platforms, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, platform engineering, or GPU/AI compute architectures
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex infrastructure, runtime, and agent platform capabilities into simple, consumable platform products and developer experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complex platform strategies to executive audiences and influence senior engineering, architecture, security, product, and business leaders without direct authority
* Proven ability to build consensus and make trade\-offs across competing customer, engineering, architecture, security, operational, and business priorities

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, or a related discipline
* Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU compute, model serving, LLM inference, agent runtimes, agentic platforms, agent orchestration frameworks, multi\-agent systems, or AI runtime platforms
* Experience with Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, NVIDIA GPU technologies, or other large\-scale container and accelerated\-compute environments
* Experience with enterprise AI or cloud AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, or similar technologies
* Experience with agent deployment, execution, orchestration, lifecycle management, observability, or tool connectivity patterns
* Experience building platforms spanning private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid environments
* Experience with developer self\-service, platform engineering, observability, capacity management, FinOps, or AI governance integration
* Experience delivering technology platforms within large\-scale or highly regulated enterprises

 **The Candidate We're Looking For**

* The solid candidate will think of infrastructure, runtime, and agent platform capabilities as products rather than simply technologies.
* You should be comfortable moving between AI workloads, agent workloads, GPU compute, Kubernetes, APIs, developer experience, platform economics, and executive strategy without needing to be the deepest engineer in every technology.
* You enjoy taking complex infrastructure and agent platform capabilities and making them simple for developers to consume. You can make decisions while technology and customer requirements are changing rapidly, and influence a large organization through technical credibility, product thinking, and a clear vision for where the platform needs to go.

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: E-Commerce Manager
description:
We are seeking a results\-driven and strategic **E\-Commerce Manager** to lead our online sales initiatives and digital growth strategy. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing our e\-commerce platforms, optimizing customer experience, driving online sales, and coordinating digital marketing campaigns to ensure strong brand presence and business growth.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **E\-Commerce Strategy \& Management**
* Develop and implement e\-commerce strategies to drive revenue growth and customer acquisition.
* Oversee day\-to\-day management of the company’s online store(s), including product listings, pricing, promotions, and content.
* Monitor and optimize key performance indicators (KPIs) such as conversion rates, traffic, average order value (AOV), and return on ad spend (ROAS).
* **Digital Marketing \& Sales**
* Collaborate with marketing teams to execute SEO/SEM, email marketing, PPC, affiliate marketing, and social media campaigns.
* Manage digital advertising budgets and performance across platforms (Google Ads, Meta, etc.).
* Lead A/B testing to optimize website performance, UX/UI, and conversion funnels
* Strong knowledge of e\-commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify, Magento, BigCommerce).
* **Product \& Inventory Management**
* Coordinate with product, inventory, and logistics teams to ensure accurate stock levels, product availability, and timely order fulfillment.
* Manage product lifecycle on the e\-commerce platform, including new launches, seasonal updates, and discontinuations.
* **Platform \& Technology Oversight**
* Ensure the e\-commerce platform (e.g., Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce) is fully functional, secure, and up\-to\-date.
* Work with developers and third\-party vendors to improve site functionality and resolve technical issues.
* **Customer Experience \& Support**
* Ensure a seamless online shopping experience, from browsing to checkout.
* Monitor and respond to customer reviews, complaints, and inquiries in coordination with the customer service team.
* **Analytics \& Reporting**
* Generate and analyze sales and traffic reports to identify trends and opportunities.
* Prepare weekly/monthly performance reports and present findings to senior management.

Vcare: Digital Marketing Executive – Job Description

Strong problem\-solving ability

Result\-oriented mindset

Pay: ₹45,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

title: Commercial Banking: Mid Corporate Relationship Manager - Senior Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Mid\-Corp Relationship Manager is a strategic professional who closely follows latest trends in own field and adapts them for application within own job and the business. Typically a small number of people within the business that provide the same level of expertise. Excellent communication skills required in order to negotiate internally, often at a senior level. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Accountable for significant direct business results or authoritative advice regarding the operations of the business. Necessitates a degree of responsibility over technical strategy. Primarily affects a sub\-function. Responsible for handling staff management issues, including resource management and allocation of work within the team/project.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**


* Calls on clients to deepen relationships and proactively owns, responds to, uncovers and anticipates future needs, roadblocks or risks and expectations
* Introduces solutions to clients in building and strengthening an effective portfolio;
* Works with product specialists and subject matter experts to structure innovative and customized solutions that meet clients’ individual needs
* Works closely with Case Manager on the on\-boarding and retention of clients, ensuring the appropriate “Know Your Client” (KYC) and other compliance deliverables are met;
* Identifies cross\-sell opportunities to deepen and increase share of wallet;
* Maximizes client experience by proactive sharing markets updates, trend and intelligence
* Drives innovation in the solutions we provide clients and further developing our business where necessary and appropriate
* Execution of strategic initiatives launched centrally at all levels (Group, Bank, commercial market and EIB)
* Networks with clients to identify avenues for new business opportunities;
* Administrate the credit relationship of the client, coordinating and supervising the entire process, ensuring the proper application of policies and institutional processes
* Ensures compliance with regulatory requirements and Citi's policies / guidelines at all time
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
  

  

**Qualifications:**


* 10\+ years of experience
* Sound knowledge of banking and investment products and process as well as a track record of providing sound banking and financial advice and solutions to clients
* Demonstrates intermediate to advanced credit skills; structures more complex deals, including global transactions
* Demonstrates an expert level of Early Warning Detection skills
* Demonstrates expert level credit skills; capable of structuring all credit deals and guiding staff through the credit deal approval process
* Demonstrates advanced Citi’s credit\-process and credit\-appetite knowledge
* Ability to work effectively in team setting
* Ability to coordinate multi\-functional teams to provide an exceptional client experience.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and influencing skills (e.g. negotiation, consultative skills, leadership)
* Ability to work under pressure while making sound decisions
* Highly focused, able to rapidly identify key priorities, clearly communicate the priorities
* Accountable for significant direct business results or authoritative advice regarding the operations of the business.
* A proactive approach in looking for ways in strengthening business relationship with clients, delivers a simple, secure and seamless client experience
* Ability to embrace new technology and understand the role digital plays in the experience we deliver for our clients
* Able to quickly adapt priorities based on the latest data insights
  

  

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s/University degree, Masters degree preferred
